datasets.name: DamSegment
datasets.citation: V. Gharehbaghi, C. R. Bennett, R. Lequesne, H. Zhao and J. Li, DamSegment, Mendeley Data, V1, 2025, doi:10.17632/z5z6gtt5t4.1
datasets.route: direct download from Mendeley Data, no sign-up
datasets.notes: 1500 photographs of concrete, 640x640, Easy/Medium/Hard sets of 500, with crack and spalling masks. The archive keeps the dataset's own spelling, 'Damage Segmentaion'.

datasets.name: HPatches
datasets.aggregates: yes (MIT, as declared by the authors on the dataset's own Hugging Face release and in its repository)
datasets.citation: V. Balntas, K. Lenc, A. Vedaldi and K. Mikolajczyk, "HPatches: A benchmark and evaluation of handcrafted and learned local descriptors", CVPR 2017
datasets.route: direct download from the authors' Hugging Face dataset, no sign-up; the URL is pinned to a revision
datasets.notes: Only the image sequences: 116 planar scenes of 6 images each, with the homography from the first image to each other one (H_1_k). 'i_' sequences change illumination at a fixed viewpoint, 'v_' sequences change viewpoint. The 4.2 GB patch release is not registered.

datasets.name: POT-210

licence.text: none stated; the paper says the benchmark is made available for research purposes

datasets.citation: P. Liang, Y. Wu, H. Lu, L. Wang, C. Liao and H. Ling, "Planar Object Tracking in the Wild: A Benchmark", ICRA 2018
datasets.route: the project page returned 404 when checked on 2026-10-16; an archived copy links per-object downloads
datasets.notes: 210 videos of 30 planar objects, 500 frames each at 1280x720, every other frame annotated with four corners. Size not stated at the source.

datasets.name: PlanarTrack
datasets.aggregates: unclear: non-commercial research only; needs the authors' confirmation for this project
datasets.citation: X. Liu, X. Liu, Z. Yi, X. Zhou, T. Le, L. Zhang, Y. Huang, Q. Yang and H. Fan, "PlanarTrack: A Large-scale Challenging Benchmark for Planar Object Tracking", ICCV 2023
datasets.route: OneDrive share linked from the project page and https://github.com/HengLan/PlanarTrack; annotations separately on Google Drive or OneDrive
datasets.notes: 1000 videos, about 490k frames, four corners per frame. About 107 GB, as stated on the project page.

datasets.name: REVIEW

licence.text: terms of use: view and download free of charge for research and educational purposes; no commercial use, copying or redistribution

datasets.aggregates: unclear: research and educational use only; needs the owners' confirmation for this project
datasets.citation: B. Al-Diri, A. Hunter, D. Steel, M. Habib, T. Hudaib and S. Berry, "REVIEW - A Reference Data Set for Retinal Vessel Profiles", EMBC 2008
datasets.route: the site did not respond when checked on 2026-10-16; only archived pages remain; contact the authors
datasets.notes: 16 images, 193 vessel segments, 5066 profiles whose edges three observers marked. About 56 MB, as stated on the archived download page.

datasets.name: Duke OCT DME

licence.text: "Images are intended for use in research and educational settings. Commercialization/redistribution of the images is prohibited." Citation required.

datasets.aggregates: unclear: research and educational use only; needs the owners' confirmation for this project
datasets.citation: S. J. Chiu, M. J. Allingham, P. S. Mettu, S. W. Cousins, J. A. Izatt and S. Farsiu, "Kernel regression based segmentation of optical coherence tomography images with diabetic macular edema", Biomedical Optics Express 6(4), 1172-1194, 2015
datasets.route: direct download of a zip from the lab page, no sign-up
datasets.notes: 110 B-scans from 10 patients, layer boundaries marked by two experts.

datasets.name: Duke OCT AMD

licence.text: the lab's terms: research purposes only, no commercialization or redistribution without written permission; citation required

datasets.aggregates: unclear: research use only; needs the owners' confirmation for this project
datasets.citation: S. J. Chiu, J. A. Izatt, R. V. O'Connell, K. P. Winter, C. A. Toth and S. Farsiu, "Validated Automatic Segmentation of AMD Pathology including Drusen and Geographic Atrophy in SDOCT Images", IOVS 53(1), 53-61, 2012
datasets.route: direct download of a zip from the lab page, no sign-up
datasets.notes: The lab's larger AMD set (Farsiu et al., Ophthalmology 2014) is over 20 GB, under the same terms.

datasets.name: DRIVE

licence.text: none stated on the public page; the download needs a Grand Challenge account

datasets.aggregates: unclear: no licence is stated publicly
datasets.citation: J. Staal, M. D. Abramoff, M. Niemeijer, M. A. Viergever and B. van Ginneken, "Ridge-based vessel segmentation in color images of the retina", IEEE TMI 23(4), 501-509, 2004
datasets.route: sign-up on grand-challenge.org, then the challenge's download page
datasets.notes: 40 images, 768x584; one manual segmentation for the 20 training images, the test labels are withheld. No width annotations.

datasets.name: HRF
datasets.aggregates: yes, with attribution: "We release it under Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution License"
datasets.citation: A. Budai, R. Bock, A. Maier, J. Hornegger and G. Michelson, "Robust Vessel Segmentation in Fundus Images", International Journal of Biomedical Imaging, 2013
datasets.route: direct download from the FAU page, no sign-up
datasets.notes: 45 fundus images with one binary vessel segmentation each. No width or paired-edge annotations, and one observer, so it does not meet the two-boundary benchmark's need for several observers. Files are registered when a tool first uses it.

datasets.name: Crack500

licence.text: none stated; the repository has no licence file and asks for citation

datasets.citation: L. Zhang, F. Yang, Y. D. Zhang and Y. J. Zhu, "Road crack detection using deep convolutional neural network", ICIP 2016; F. Yang, L. Zhang, S. Yu, D. Prokhorov, X. Mei and H. Ling, "Feature Pyramid and Hierarchical Boosting Network for Pavement Crack Detection", IEEE T-ITS, 2019
datasets.route: a Google Drive, OneDrive or Baidu bundle of several crack datasets, linked from the repository
datasets.notes: 500 pavement images of about 2000x1500 with pixel masks. Size of the bundle not stated.

datasets.name: CFD

licence.text: "The dataset is made available for non-commercial research purposes only."

datasets.aggregates: unclear: non-commercial research only; needs the author's confirmation for this project
datasets.citation: Y. Shi, L. Cui, Z. Qi, F. Meng and Z. Chen, "Automatic road crack detection using random structured forests", IEEE T-ITS 17(12), 3434-3445, 2016
datasets.route: clone or download the GitHub repository, no sign-up
datasets.notes: 118 road images, 480x320, with crack masks. About 10 MB, the repository's size.

datasets.name: GAN_Synth_Adhesive

licence.text: none stated; the repository has no licence file, so all rights are reserved

datasets.aggregates: no: local, qualitative use only; nothing derived from it is committed or published
datasets.citation: R. S. Peres, M. Azevedo, S. O. Araujo, M. Guedes, F. Miranda and J. Barata, "Generative Adversarial Networks for Data Augmentation in Structural Adhesive Inspection", Applied Sciences 11(7), 3086, 2021
datasets.route: the adhesive1024.zip release of the repository; download it yourself
datasets.notes: Real 1024x1024 images of adhesive beads with defects, without centrelines.
